personality_one_liner: A highly professional, institutional Turkish administrative dashboard with sharp typography, focused on operational clarity and functional trust.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-native padding. Group related scheduling elements closely, but give structural elements breathing room. Sticky CTA over scrolling content is required.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar
Use glass on sticky month/year selector header
Use glass on floating 'Şablonu Uygula' button container
dont's: No glass on regular calendar day cells
No glass on form inputs or bottom sheet content

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure PIN gate to access the ASM dashboard.

states.loading: Subtle loading spinner in place of PIN dots
states.error: Shake animation and red 'Hatalı PIN' text

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). Clean numeric keypad (NumPad) at the bottom 40%. Large 'ASM Nöbet Çizelgesi' typography. No decorative graphics, strict institutional feel.

screens.name: CalendarDashboard
screens.purpose: Interactive monthly calendar for 2026-2027 highlighting coverage, holidays, and templates.

states.error: Toast with retry for sync issues

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with left/right arrows for Month/Year switching. Day-of-week header row (Pzt...Paz). 7-column calendar grid. Cells have day number; tap to open Daily Assignment sheet. 'Resmi Tatil' days have a tinted red background and red text. Assigned physicians appear as colored dot tags in the cell. A sticky glass floating CTA 'Şablonu Ay Geneline Uygula' sits above the bottom tab bar. Subtle footer text: 'Yazılım ve Geliştirme: Dr. Furkan Aksoy'.

screens.name: DailyAssignmentSheet
screens.purpose: Bottom sheet to assign physicians or mark holidays for a specific day.
screens.layout: BottomSheet. Header: Date (e.g. 15 Ocak Çarşamba). Prominent switch/toggle: 'Resmi Tatil / İdari İzin (ASM Kapalı)' - toggling this disables physician selection. List of physicians with checkboxes for multiselect. Real-time warning banner if < 2 physicians (or custom threshold) are assigned. Sticky 'Kaydet' button.

screens.name: HekimlerVeSablon
screens.purpose: Manage physician list and define the recurring weekly template.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Henüz hekim eklenmedi' and Add button.

screens.layout: Two sections or tabs. 1: Hekim Listesi (Add/Edit/Delete, assign color tags like A, B, C). 2: Haftalık Şablon (List of days Pzt-Cum, tap to select which physicians work each day). Minimalistic cards for each physician.

screens.name: AylikOzet
screens.purpose: Summary metrics showing fair distribution of shifts.
screens.layout: Month selector at top. Vertical list of physicians. Each row shows total working days for the month with a simple progress bar indicating load distribution.

login_bg.alt: Modern government building with Turkish flag

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: No blues or purples. Base is graphite/near-black, accent/holidays use red (error token).
Implement Turkish calendar rules: Week starts on Monday (Pzt). All UI text must be in Turkish (Aylık Çalışma Çizelgesi, Hekim Listesi, Resmi Tatil).
Mark 2026-2027 Turkish Official/Religious holidays automatically with a red indicator (e.g., cell background at 10% opacity of error token + error token text).
Use a gradient scrim over the login background image (Layer 0: image, Layer 1: linear gradient to surfaceInverse, Layer 2: PIN pad and text).
Use Plus Jakarta Sans exclusively for a formal, readable, tabular aesthetic.
Add developer credit 'Yazılım ve Geliştirme: Dr. Furkan Aksoy' subtly on the main dashboard screen.
Do not use generic emojis anywhere in the app. Rely on Ionicons and color dots for status.
Ensure the 'Şablonu Ay Geneline Uygula' button is a prominent sticky CTA over the scrolling calendar.
Implement real-time coverage warnings (Amber/Red) if scheduling conflicts or under-staffing occur in the Daily Assignment sheet.
